key_catalyst: Oil supply shock escalating intraday — crude at a five-week high with supply risks building on top of the active Bab el-Mandeb blockade (Brent >$90)
reasoning: The morning's oil-supply shock did not resolve intraday — it escalated: crude pushed to a five-week high with 'supply risks building' on top of an ACTUAL Bab el-Mandeb blockade and Brent north of $90, and the risk-off tone spilled into crypto equities selling off with the broader tape. Yet QQQ closed the session only +0.25% despite a powerful chip/AI rally (Intel +8.6%, AMD +8.1%, SOXX +5.5%), meaning equities barely advanced against a huge sector tailwind — the oil drag is being absorbed but the hard supply premium is not fully repriced into risk assets. What remains unresolved is where oil settles in the Asia/Europe overnight session with an active shipping blockade still in force.
